title: Default BDD to isolated mock providers
description: Ordinary npm run bdd currently selects real provider paths outside CI, risking unintended paid synthesis during local validation. The first P18 full run failed ten provider/worker cases and its overwritten log cannot establish whether external requests completed. Add a dedicated test launcher that always selects repository CI mocks and strips provider credentials/SDK metadata credential sources for ordinary BDD; explicit real model/cloud acceptance remains separate. Preserve Node20 compatibility and coverage invocation. Add executable tests proving caller CI=false and supplied credential env cannot enable real providers through this launcher; then rerun complete BDD with retained unique logs. No deployment or live provider test. Follow Babulus commit approval gate.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented isolated ordinary BDD launcher: CI mocks forced, provider credential environment and AWS metadata/config sources removed. Full default launcher suite passed 418 scenarios/2119 steps with caller CI=false and fake credentials; retained /tmp/babulus-622c9b-full-bdd.log. Targeted provider/isolation checks passed on Node20 and26 (13 scenarios/78 steps each); dedicated render authority tests passed 28 each. Root lint and Studio predeploy mirror passed. Independent Terra review cleared launcher scope. This is mock-path isolation, not a general OS network sandbox. Initial overwritten failed run cannot establish whether an external provider request completed. Commit approval requested from user; no commits or deployment yet.
